changelog:
Initial release: Generate professional PPTX slides with 4 built-in visual templates and automated layout.

- One-click generation of structured and stylish .pptx presentations.
- Four template styles: business, tech, academic, and creative.
- Auto-alignment ensures consistent rounded corners, shadows, and spacing.
- Supports full slide structure: cover, catalog, content pages, summary, and image placeholders.
- Outputs neatly formatted presentations in 4:3 or 16:9 aspect ratios.
